| Neighbourhood | Listings | Occupancy Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Pollença | 2,274 | 74.3% |
| Alcúdia | 1,382 | 75.8% |
| Santanyí | 1,014 | 72.6% |
| Palma de Mallorca | 982 | 68.2% |
| Manacor | 801 | 70.9% |

**Key takeaways:**
- **Alcúdia** leads with the highest occupancy at <citation-number id="query_fc754969" column="occupancy_rate">75.8</citation-number>%, despite being the 2nd largest neighbourhood by listings.
- **Pollença**, the largest neighbourhood with <citation-number id="query_fc754969" column="listing_count">2,274</citation-number> listings, follows closely at <citation-number id="query_fc754969" column="occupancy_rate">74.3</citation-number>%.
- **Palma de Mallorca** has the lowest occupancy at <citation-number id="query_fc754969" column="occupancy_rate">68.2</citation-number>%, which may reflect its more urban, year-round market compared to the coastal/resort areas.
- All five neighbourhoods show strong summer demand, with occupancy rates between 68–76% — typical of peak season in Mallorca.

args.sql_query:
WITH top_neighbourhoods AS (
    SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count
    FROM listings
    GROUP BY neighbourhood
    ORDER BY listing_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
july_calendar AS (
    SELECT
        c.listing_id,
        c.available
    FROM calendar c
    WHERE c.date >= '2026-07-01' AND c.date <= '2026-07-31'
),
occupancy AS (
    SELECT
        l.neighbourhood,
        COUNT(*) AS total_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN jc.available = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_days
    FROM july_calendar jc
    JOIN listings l ON l.id = jc.listing_id
    JOIN top_neighbourhoods tn ON tn.neighbourhood = l.neighbourhood
    GROUP BY l.neighbourhood
)
SELECT
    o.neighbourhood,
    tn.listing_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * o.booked_days / o.total_days, 1) AS occupancy_rate
FROM occupancy o
JOIN top_neighbourhoods tn ON tn.neighbourhood = o.neighbourhood
ORDER BY tn.listing_count DESC;

details.reference_sql:
WITH top5 AS (
  SELECT neighbourhood FROM listings
  GROUP BY neighbourhood ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5
),
july AS (
  SELECT listing_id,
         COUNT(*) AS nights,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT available) AS unavailable
  FROM calendar
  WHERE date >= '2026-07-01' AND date < '2026-08-01'
  GROUP BY listing_id
)
SELECT l.neighbourhood,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(j.unavailable) / SUM(j.nights), 2) AS pct_unavailable_july
FROM july j
JOIN listings l ON l.id = j.listing_id
WHERE l.neighbourhood IN (SELECT neighbourhood FROM top5)
GROUP BY l.neighbourhood

Here's the breakdown of listings by Mallorca regional tourist license status:

| Status | Listings |
|---|---|
| **Registered** | <citation-number id="query_d4f82daf" column="listings">13,240</citation-number> |
| **Exempt** | <citation-number id="query_d4f82daf" column="listings">1,348</citation-number> |
| **No Regional Entry** | <citation-number id="query_d4f82daf" column="listings">166</citation-number> |
| **No Data** | <citation-number id="query_d4f82daf" column="listings">147</citation-number> |

**Classification logic used:**
- **Registered** — license contains "Mallorca - Regional registration number" with an actual registration code (e.g. `AT/1877`, `AG/6`, `ETV/3025`)
- **Exempt** — license contains "Mallorca - Regional registration number" followed by an "Exempt" mention (e.g. seasonal rental, hotel)
- **No Regional Entry** — license exists but has no Mallorca regional section at all (only Spain national entries or other regions)
- **No Data** — license field is null

args.sql_query:
SELECT CASE WHEN license IS NULL THEN 'No Data' WHEN license NOT ILIKE '%Mallorca - Regional registration number%' THEN 'No Regional Entry' WHEN license ILIKE '%Mallorca - Regional registration number%
Exempt%' THEN 'Exempt' ELSE 'Registered' END AS tourist_license_status, COUNT(*) AS listings FROM listings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY listings DESC;
args.name: Listings by Mallorca tourist license status

args.title: Listings by Mallorca Tourist License Status

suggestions: Can you break down the 'Exempt' category by exemption type (e.g. seasonal rental, hotel, tourist apartment)?
How does the license status distribution vary by neighbourhood or city?

details.reference_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN license IS NULL THEN 'no data'
    WHEN license !~ 'Mallorca - Regional registration number' THEN 'no regional entry'
    WHEN substring(license from 'Mallorca - Regional registration number\s*[\r\n]+\s*([^\r\n]+)') ILIKE 'exempt%' THEN 'regional: exempt'
    ELSE 'regional: registered'
  END AS license_status,
  COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM listings
GROUP BY 1
